title: Business Analysis
intro: Understand the business before the numbers. These concepts come mainly from the 10-K (Item 1 “Business”, Item 1A “Risk Factors”, segment notes) and earnings calls.
he: קודם להבין את העסק — ורק אחר כך את המספרים.

title: Income Statement
intro: Also called the P&L (Profit & Loss). It shows how revenue flows down to net income over a period — a quarter (10-Q) or a year (10-K).
he: דוח רווח והפסד: מההכנסות מורידים עלויות שלב אחר שלב עד לרווח הנקי.
top:

title: Profitability & Margins
intro: Margins turn dollar profits into percentages so you can compare across time and companies. Each margin answers: “of every $100 of revenue, how much is left at this level?”
he: שולי רווח — מתוך כל 100$ הכנסות, כמה נשאר בכל שלב.

title: Cash Flow
intro: Profit is an accounting opinion; cash is a fact. The cash flow statement shows where cash actually came from and went.
he: תזרים מזומנים — מאיפה הגיע המזומן ולאן הוא הלך בפועל.

title: Capital Efficiency
intro: Profitability alone is insufficient — what matters is how much capital was needed to earn that profit.
he: לא רק כמה מרוויחים — אלא כמה הון היה צריך כדי להרוויח את זה.
top:
Why profit alone is not enough

CompanyProfit (NOPAT)Capital usedReturn on capital
A$3B$15B20%
B$4B$40B10%

B earns more dollars, but A is the far more efficient business: each $1 of capital produces twice as much profit. If both reinvest, A compounds value much faster.

title: Per-Share Metrics
intro: You own shares, not the company. A company can grow while each existing share gets a smaller slice — always look at per-share economics.
he: אתה מחזיק מניות, לא את החברה. תמיד לבדוק נתונים למניה.

title: Valuation
intro: Multiples compare what the market charges with what the business produces.
top:
GREAT COMPANY ≠ GREAT INVESTMENT

A fantastic business can still be a poor investment if you buy it at an excessive valuation. The return you earn depends on the price you pay relative to the cash the business will produce.

חברה מצוינת יכולה להיות השקעה גרועה אם קונים אותה במחיר מופרז.

title: Discounted Cash Flow — DCF
intro: A company is worth the present value of the cash it can generate for its owners in the future. Because future money is worth less than money today, future cash flows are discounted back to today.
he: חברה שווה את הערך הנוכחי של כל המזומנים שתייצר בעתיד.
top:
The DCF process

1. Revenue ForecastProject sales for 5–10 years from growth drivers.
→
2. Margin ForecastProject operating / FCF margins.
→
3. FCF ForecastRevenue × FCF margin = FCF each year.
→
4. Discount FCFPV = FCFₜ / (1+r)ᵗ for each year.
→
5. Terminal ValueValue of all cash after the forecast.
→
6. Enterprise ValueSum of PV of FCF + PV of TV.
→
7. Equity ValueEV − Debt + Cash.
→
8. Fair Value Per ShareEquity Value / Diluted Shares.

title: Investment Thesis
intro: A short written argument for why a stock is mispriced and what will make the market see it.
top:
WHAT WOULD PROVE ME WRONG?

Confirmation bias is the tendency to seek and believe information that supports what we already think. Once you own a stock, every piece of news starts to look like support. The defence: define thesis-breaking conditions before investing, in writing, with numbers — then act on them when they happen.

מה יוכיח שטעיתי? להגדיר מראש, בכתב, לפני הקנייה.

Examples: revenue growth falls below X% · margins fall below X% · major customer lost · competitor gains significant share · debt rises above X · product launch fails · regulatory change.
